_schema: Each entry is { count, authority }. `count` is diffed against a live scan; the guard fails on any INCREASE (A4a) and flags a DECREASE as a stale baseline. `authority` is the ruling that exempts the literal (R-BL21) — R-H8 / R-#fff / R-S9 / UNSCOPED-P2 — so a future reader knows WHY it is exempt, not just that it is. Regenerate with GENERATE_TOKEN_GUARD_BASELINE=1; new entries land as UNTAGGED and fail the authority test until a ruling is cited.
